q.bn: Report করো: "I am tired," she said.

options.en: She said she is tired.
options.bn: She said she is tired.

options.en: She said she was tired.
options.bn: She said she was tired.

options.en: She said I was tired.
options.bn: She said I was tired.

options.en: She said she were tired.
options.bn: She said she were tired.

why.en: "Am" backshifts to "was", and the pronoun shifts from "I" to "she".
why.bn: "Am" backshift হয়ে "was" হয়, এবং pronoun "I" থেকে "she" হয়ে যায়।

q.en: Report: "I will call you tomorrow," he said.
q.bn: Report করো: "I will call you tomorrow," he said.

options.en: He said he will call me tomorrow.
options.bn: He said he will call me tomorrow.

options.en: He said he would call me the next day.
options.bn: He said he would call me the next day.

options.en: He said he would call me tomorrow.
options.bn: He said he would call me tomorrow.

options.en: He said he will call me the next day.
options.bn: He said he will call me the next day.

why.en: "Will" backshifts to "would", and the time word "tomorrow" shifts to "the next day".
why.bn: "Will" backshift হয়ে "would" হয়, আর time word "tomorrow" হয়ে যায় "the next day"।

q.en: Fix: "He told to me to wait here."
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "He told to me to wait here."

options.en: He told me to wait there.
options.bn: He told me to wait there.

options.en: He told to me to wait there.
options.bn: He told to me to wait there.

options.en: He told me to wait here.
options.bn: He told me to wait here.

options.en: He said me to wait there.
options.bn: He said me to wait there.

why.en: "Tell" takes a direct object with no "to" before it, and "here" also shifts to "there" in reported speech.
why.bn: "Tell"-এর পরে সরাসরি object আসে, "to" লাগে না, এবং "here" reported speech-এ "there" হয়ে যায়।

q.en: Report the command: "Don't touch that," she said.
q.bn: Command report করো: "Don't touch that," she said.

options.en: She told me don't touch that.
options.bn: She told me don't touch that.

options.en: She told me to not touch that.
options.bn: She told me to not touch that.

options.en: She told me not to touch that.
options.bn: She told me not to touch that.

options.en: She said me not touch that.
options.bn: She said me not touch that.

why.en: Negative reported commands use "not to + base verb" after tell/ask + object.
why.bn: Negative reported command-এ tell/ask + object-এর পরে "not to + base verb" বসে।

q.en: "The sun rises in the east," she said. Why is backshift optional here?
q.bn: "The sun rises in the east," she said. — এখানে backshift optional কেন?

options.en: Because it's a question.
options.bn: কারণ এটা একটা question।

options.en: Because it's a general truth that's still true.
options.bn: কারণ এটা একটা general truth যা এখনো সত্য।

options.en: Because "rises" has no past form.
options.bn: কারণ "rises"-এর কোনো past form নেই।

options.en: Because it's a command.
options.bn: কারণ এটা একটা command।

why.en: When the reported fact is still true or a general truth, backshifting the tense is optional.
why.bn: Reported fact এখনো সত্য হলে বা general truth হলে, tense backshift করা optional।
